title: Privacy-Preserving Data Sharing in Agriculture: Enforcing Policy Rules for Secure and Confidential Data Synthesis
summary: A research tool for policy-enforced, privacy-preserving synthetic data generation in agricultural datasets, using a trained generative model to sample synthetic tabular records. It loads and samples from a trained model via the standalone CTGAN package's CTGANSynthesizer to produce the synthetic tables.
